profile_text.body:
Netflix is a publicly traded entertainment company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, and listed under the ticker NFLX. Its investor site describes it as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. The company says members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix reports over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries. Its SEC filings are registered under CIK 0001065280.

The company's recorded legal exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 entries. The site material reviewed does not describe AI-specific products or services.
